name: Nsukka
scopeLimits: This is city-source research, not a boundary or completeness assertion. No owner, address, tax, account, or other personal property data were requested or retained. No authentication, CAPTCHA, applicant form, or identifier-based property lookup was used. No full parcel polygons were retained.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: The Enugu State Government’s ENGIS identifies itself as the state digital land-administration platform and lists a Nsukka zonal land center. Its Surveyor General’s public maps page describes mapped parcel/property boundaries and official land records. This confirms a Nsukka-linked state land-service center, but not WUP-point coverage.
technicalBlocker: A local registry/service center and an official parcel map offering are confirmed. The public map route includes owner/address/parcel search and the viewer launch requires login, so no anonymous schema-safe geometry path was verified.
remainingUncertainty: Whether a separate anonymous geometry-only endpoint exists for Nsukka that does not expose title/owner/address data and whether this location is covered.
nextStep: Use only an official public layer metadata source that explicitly separates geometry from personal/title attributes; do not authenticate or submit survey numbers, coordinates, address, or owner terms.

executedQueries.result: English and Igbo-oriented local-language searches surfaced the official Enugu State ENGIS platform and its Nsukka zonal land center. The Surveyor General map page advertises public map viewing, but it also supports survey-number and owner/address/parcel searches. The Launch Map Viewer link redirects to an account login. No login, search term, or parcel identifier was supplied; no field schema or geometry was queried.
